snippet.description:
Jacobian determinant solved examples, concept, formulas, and coordinate transformation in multivariable calculus for B.Sc. Maths and Engineering students.

Is video mein hum advanced calculus ka ek bahut hi important topic cover kar rahe hain — Jacobian (जैकोबियन). Hum samjhenge ki variable transformation ke dauran local area scale kaise change hota hai, Jacobian matrix aur Jacobian determinant kya hote hain, aur inka geometric significance kya hai.

Saath hi, 2-variable aur 3-variable transformations ke classic university exam problems step-by-step solve kiye gaye hain:

📌 Topics Covered in This Video:
Polar coordinates transformation ($x = r\cos\theta, y = r\sin\theta$)
Hyperbolic function problems
3-variable system solved step-by-step using determinant properties
Agar aap B.Sc. Maths, B.Tech/Engineering Mathematics, ya CSIR NET / IIT JAM ki preparation kar rahe hain, toh yeh lecture aapke concepts clear karne ke liye bohot helpful hoga!

Timestamps
00:00 – Recap of Implicit Differentiation & Lecture Overview
01:20 – Geometric Intuition & Area Scaling in Coordinate Transformation
03:22 – Introduction to Partial Derivatives & Coordinate Shift
05:12 – Definition of Jacobian Matrix & Jacobian Determinant
09:20 – How to Calculate 2x2 Jacobian Determinants
10:42 – Jacobian for 3 Variables ($u, v, w$)
12:00 – Generalization to $n$-Variable Systems
13:05 – Special Case: Triangular Matrix & Diagonal Multiplication
14:52 – Example 1: Polar Coordinate Transformation ($x = r\cos\theta, y = r\sin\theta$)
21:38 – Example 2: Hyperbolic Coordinate System Transformation
27:26 – Example 3: 3-Variable System & Row Operations Simplification
35:40 – Example 4: Advanced 3-Variable Coordinate System Problem
57:15 – Summary & Upcoming Lecture Preview (Implicit Functions)

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd
